lead.headline: Solana validators accelerate SOL disinflation in first binding governance vote
lead.tldr: Solana's first binding governance vote to accelerate token disinflation passed after Kraken flipped from opposition to support, signaling that validator economics and institutional ETF flows are now structurally linked in how the chain reprices.

intro: Dear Founders, Investors, and Friends, today the throughline runs through Solana's validator economics and the institutional capital now pricing it in real time.

top_signals.title: SBI Holdings invests $270 million in Ajaib, taking 20% stake amid Asia digital asset push
top_signals.summary: SBI Holdings has invested $270 million to acquire a 20% stake in Ajaib, a digital asset platform. This move is part of SBI's broader strategy to expand its digital asset footprint across Asia.
top_signals.why_it_matters: SBI's $270M for 20% of Ajaib is a strategic control premium on Asia's underbuilt digital asset distribution, not a valuation benchmark for the sector.

top_signals.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
top_signals.summary: Solana validators have approved its first binding governance vote to accelerate the disinflation of the SOL token supply. The proposal passed after Kraken shifted its position from opposition to support.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Kraken's position flip on Solana disinflation reveals that exchange staking economics are now a binding constraint on validator governance outcomes.

top_signals.title: Bullish provides USD.AI $100M stablecoin facility for GPU-backed lending
top_signals.summary: Bullish has provided a $100 million stablecoin facility to USD.AI to support lending backed by GPU infrastructure. This move highlights the growth of onchain private credit specifically targeting AI computing resources.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Bullish's $100M facility for GPU-backed lending shows stablecoin issuers are now underwriting compute scarcity as a collateral class, with implications for DeFi risk models.

top_signals.title: Bitwise fund is first Solana ETF to hit $1 billion AUM
top_signals.summary: The Bitwise Solana Staking ETF (BSOL) has become the first Solana ETF to reach $1 billion in assets under management. This milestone was achieved in less than a year since the fund's launch.
top_signals.why_it_matters: BSOL hitting $1B AUM in under a year means institutional Solana exposure is repricing faster than the underlying tokenomics can adjust, creating a basis risk between ETF flows and validator rewards.

top_signals.title: BitGo buys NYDIG trading arm to deepen institutional crypto push
top_signals.summary: BitGo has acquired the institutional trading arm of NYDIG to strengthen its institutional crypto offerings. The deal includes the acquisition of approximately 30 employees and existing client relationships, focusing on expanding derivatives and financing services.
top_signals.why_it_matters: BitGo absorbing NYDIG's trading arm is vertical consolidation of the institutional crypto stack: custody, derivatives, and financing under one roof, with client relationships as the actual purchase price.

Bitfinex Securities has successfully completed a $50 million tokenized capital raise for Alkemya. The funding was achieved through the issuance of ALKN, a tokenized security representing limited partnership interests.

French Bitcoin treasury firm Capital B has raised $24.5 million through a private placement to expand its BTC holdings. The round saw participation from notable figures including BlockStream's Adam Back and TOBAM, with potential for further funding via warrants.

on_the_radar.title: Visa works with Upbit parent on stablecoin payments, AI commerce40m
on_the_radar.summary: Visa is collaborating with the parent company of Upbit to integrate stablecoin payments and AI-driven commerce solutions. This partnership aims to bridge traditional financial infrastructure with digital asset payment rails.

on_the_radar.title: Dunamu and Visa partner on stablecoin, AI business; Open Standard's OUSD under consideration
on_the_radar.summary: Dunamu and Visa have entered a partnership to explore business opportunities involving stablecoins and artificial intelligence. The collaboration is specifically considering the integration of Open Standard's OUSD for future use cases.

on_the_radar.title: Abu Dhabi royal backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture: WSJ11m, Abu Dhabi royal backs 49% stake in Trump-linked crypto bank venture: WSJSheikh Tahnoon’s group reportedly backs a 49% stake in the holding company behind World Liberty’s conditionally approved US trust bank.
on_the_radar.summary: A group led by Abu Dhabi royal Sheikh Tahnoon is reportedly backing a 49% stake in the holding company for World Liberty's conditionally approved US trust bank. This venture links high-profile political figures and Middle Eastern capital to the US crypto banking sector.

on_the_radar.title: Charles Schwab to add Solana, Avalanche and Chainlink to crypto trading platform
on_the_radar.summary: Charles Schwab is expanding its crypto trading platform to include Solana, Avalanche, and Chainlink. This follows the initial rollout of Bitcoin and Ethereum trading for its clients.

on_the_radar.title: Chelsea FC gets a stablecoin sponsor after UK FCA warning to clubs
on_the_radar.summary: Stablecoin issuer Circle has entered into a sponsorship agreement with Chelsea FC. This partnership follows warnings from the UK's Financial Conduct Authority regarding questionable crypto-related sponsorships in football.

on_the_radar.title: Crypto Biz: Bitcoin pumps, Wall Street does the paperwork
on_the_radar.summary: Bitcoin has surged back above $80,000, driving growth in crypto-related stocks. The report also highlights record activity on Solana and Circle's growth objectives for USDC.

on_the_radar.title: Polish Olympic chief charged in Zondacrypto probe, justice minister says
on_the_radar.summary: Polish authorities have detained and charged the president of the Polish Olympic Committee, Radosław Piesiewicz, as part of an investigation into the collapsed crypto exchange Zondacrypto.

on_the_radar.title: OneKey reproduces transaction replacement attack on outdated Ledger Ethereum app35m
on_the_radar.summary: OneKey has successfully reproduced a transaction replacement attack affecting outdated versions of the Ledger Ethereum app. The vulnerability could potentially allow attackers to trick users into signing malicious transactions.

linkedin_post:
Kraken was against Solana's accelerated disinflation until it wasn't. The flip matters more than the vote itself.

We underwrite validator governance as a function of exchange staking economics now. Kraken runs one of the larger Solana staking operations. The proposal to cut issuance threatened their yield math. Then they calculated the optics of blocking a supply-contraction measure while Bitwise's BSOL hit $1 billion AUM in under a year. They chose the optics.

This is not governance as decentralized ideal. This is governance as repricing event, with ETF flows as the forcing function. BSOL's $1B means institutional capital now treats SOL supply dynamics as a tradable thesis. Validators are not setting monetary policy. They are managing basis risk between their staking yields and the inflows that now dwarf their economics.

The test: if accelerated burn actually reduces network security budget below the threshold where institutional custodians get uncomfortable, does the same ETF demand that priced in scarcity then price in fragility? We do not know the crossover point. The Dallas Fed's warning on tokenized deposits destabilizing bank funding has an analog here. Programmable scarcity is only valuable if the underlying network remains programmable at all.

We are watching where validator concentration and ETF concentration overlap. That overlap is where Solana's actual monetary policy gets made.
